title: Coulomb Balance
summary: Find the separation at which two charges push on each other with a given force.
subject: physics
learningOutcome: After winning, the student can rearrange Coulomb's law to find distance from force and charges, and knows force falls as 1/r².
hints: Which law gives the force between two point charges at rest?
Force is proportional to 1/r². Doubling r does not halve the force.
Rearrange F = k q₁q₂ / r² to get r = √(k q₁q₂ / F). Convert μC to C first.
misconceptions: Forgetting to convert μC to C or cm to m
